scripts.dev: npm run build:app && wrangler d1 migrations apply locus-identity --local && wrangler dev --port 8791
scripts.check: npm run build:app && wrangler types && tsc --noEmit && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
scripts.check:staging: npm run build:app && npm test && wrangler types --env staging && tsc --noEmit && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env staging --outdir .wrangler/dry-run-staging
scripts.migrations:list:staging: wrangler d1 migrations list locus-identity-staging --remote --env staging
scripts.migrations:apply:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply locus-identity-staging --remote --env staging
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:app && wrangler deploy --env staging
